_comment: Copy to ~/.config/lineup/zones.json, then Reload config from the menu. You set the DIVIDER lines once; the columns are the regions between them, so they're always glued with no gaps. 'dividers' has one entry per line between columns (two dividers = three columns: left | center | right). 'halfDivider' is where Hyper+[ and Hyper+] split. unit: fraction (0..1 of width) | points | pixels (physical px from the left edge — use this to land exactly on a seam).
